title: ASHLAR Act I environment asset concepts by biome and area (14 groups x 6 assets = 84 proposed concepts)
status: delivered: 28 selected PNG (14 perspective + 14 turnaround), all 1536x1024. A01-A04 perspective are existing originals referenced in place; A01-A04 turnaround are imported old turnarounds; A05-A14 (20 images) were generated with built-in image_gen; A14 selected sheets are scale-corrected edits (*_scale_v2.png) of the original generations, which are kept as drafts. These are CONCEPT REFERENCES (not engineered orthographic drawings, GLB, UV, PBR or tileable textures). Review (Opus) verdict: pending, not PASS.
overwritePolicy: never overwrite an existing output; reused originals are read-only; retries use new sidecar suffixes or a new output filename

runner.builtinTool: codex exec --enable image_generation (built-in image_gen only; no image_gen.py, no API key)

scale.rule: every cell carries its own 1.8 m H marker at the cell-local scale; sizes are PROPOSALS, not canon
scale.hLabelNote: H labels in the images are approximate visual guides; exact modelled dimensions are to be confirmed when modelling.

environmentLayoutRule: Per sheet 6 numbered cells in a 3x2 grid, one asset per cell, a local-scale H (1.8 m) marker in every cell. Perspective sheet first; the turnaround sheet depends on it and attaches its exact generated image as identity reference (4 small orthographic views LEFT/RIGHT/FRONT/BACK per cell).
moodReferenceRule: d2_webgl.png is attached ONLY to outdoor groups (A01-A09); never to Flint Delvings (mine), Gentle House (hospice), Edda's Dream, Garden of Hush or The Cradle
notes: Sizes, asset lists and designs of the 10 new groups are PROPOSALS for lookdev; they are not canon and not the final Act I layout.
A05 surfaces are concept ground samples (thin cut-out slabs), NOT claimed tileable textures; real tiles need the periodic (Moisan) pipeline.
Flint Delvings (A10) is the chalk-and-flint Act I mine (BIO-06 a), not the Act III salt mine: no salt, teal or crystal.
HEX for hospice/cradle whites, pink night-lights and Edda's Dream gold/blue are proposals (canon HEX missing or [TA]); see docs/ASHLAR_BIOME_VA_KHU_VUC_VI.md.

Reused groups A01-A04 map the old E03/E04/E01/E02 perspective PNGs (referenced in place) and their old turnaround PNGs (IMPORTED: copied exclusively without overwrite to the A01-A04 turnaround paths, sha256 verified, source label in groups/<id>/turnaround.source.txt and _runs/import_turnarounds_2026-10-20.json). Their turnaround jobs keep generate:true as plan entries, but the valid PNG exists so the runner plans skip-exists (never regenerated, never overwritten); expectedNewImages = 10 new perspective + 10 new turnaround = 20.
Prologue-only areas (Old Face 10.1, Vigil 10.2) are not Act I areas here; A02 notes 10.2 as shared churchyard material only.
counts.generateJobs (24) counts jobs flagged generate:true; 4 of them (A01-A04 turnaround) are already imported, so a dry-run shows 20 generate + 4 skip-exists + 4 reuse-existing.

Delivery 2026-10-20: all 28 selected PNG exist (1536x1024). Per-job status/delivery hold size, bytes, sha256 and provenance; _runs/delivery_inventory_2026-10-20.json is the separate inventory. A14 selected sheets are *_scale_v2.png (generation + edit); the originals are kept unchanged as drafts and recorded under supersededOutputs.

Concept references only: not engineered orthographic drawings, not GLB, not UV/PBR, not tileable textures. H labels are approximate visual guides; exact modelled dimensions must be confirmed when modelling.
